page_note: Page contains two correspondential teaching units: (1) the Word formed through mouth-parts and likened to a coin minted by five artisans (segs 0-12), and (2) new grain molded in the five elements (segs 14-22). The grain teaching is then ecclesially applied — "the building of the Church" (seg 18) and "chosen through the teachers" (seg 26) reach into the institutional present. Heavy lacunae (83.9%). Apostolic dialogue frame at seg 17 and ecclesial application bracket the otherwise correspondential grain teaching.
